audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only 3 entries (packet defect confirms). Missing a spike covering Whimsy vs your Trample stun setup.
audit.why: Lulu W text: 'turns them into an adorable critter that can't attack or cast spells' — she can polymorph you mid-Trample to strip the stack before your auto-attack stun procs, a real and currently-unmentioned interaction.

Glitterlance (Q, slow), Whimsy (W, polymorph/buff), Help Pix! (E, shield/reveal), Wild Growth (R, knockup+health+heal) are all named correctly; the polymorph-cancels-engage and Wild Growth-counters-the-all-in interactions match the kit text.
